name: Petro Silenius
headline: CTO at Ruokaboksi / Yummy
highlights: Driving forward software and AI at Ruokaboksi / Yummy, a Finnish meal-kit service
Took the product from Finland into Estonia, Czechia and Slovakia
Making AI agents fit into real workflows
summary: I'm CTO at Ruokaboksi, a meal-kit subscription platform delivering easy, healthy and delicious meals weekly to your door. I joined as the first technical hire, moved our engineering in-house from external consultancies, and now lead a team of 4 great engineers alongside sitting on the management team.
Before Ruokaboksi I spent 4 years at Lyyti building B2B event tech, and set up Dataatti Oy to do some work on the side.

Outside my day job I like talking shop and startups. I've spoken at Turku tech meetups about startup CTO life and what it actually means to be a "Product Engineer", and I run our annual company hackathon because good ideas shouldn't only happen in sprint planning. In my free time I cycle here and there, most recently on a Cube gravel bike. I'm also known for my scouting background, where I worked on projects such as a 40-person two-week all-inclusive camp in Italy.

roles.title: Chief Technology Officer
roles.description: Leading technology and AI at a meal-kit startup that focuses on delivering delicious, healthy, and easy-to-cook weekly meal plans to your doorstep. I drive and commit to the entire development lifecycle, from shaping feature specifications to guiding design, development, testing, and successful releases. I take pride in fostering a collaborative, efficient work environment with a flat hierarchy where every team member thrives. I participate in overall company decision-making and business operations as a member of the management team.

roles.title: Founder
roles.description: Dataatti offers modern and innovative takes on customer needs. We founded Dataatti with two of my university friends after winning a 10k€ hackathon and ended up doing a few projects for public and private organisations.

roles.title: IT Consultant
roles.description: Creating and operating IT systems for a family business as well as assisting in business planning. Developed B2C websites for customer companies to boost their sales.

roles.title: Senior Frontend Developer
roles.description: Developed a B2B SaaS event management product. The last few years were spent in a big role in the technical rebuilding of the product and constantly onboarding new developers to the team. On top of daily development tasks I improved our engineering practices, organised events and figured out architecture level solutions to bigger features.

roles.title: PM Thesis Worker
roles.description: My Master's thesis was an assignment for Lyyti and mainly worked on user research practices to improve product management decisions. During it I created a model for executing and utilising user research in product development projects and documented those processes in practical guides.

education.degree: Master's Degree, Industrial Engineering and Management
